newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iranian diplomats quit Kabul embassy, one left-IRNA.
newsitem.headline: Iranian diplomats quit Kabul embassy, one left-IRNA.

text.p: All but one of Iran's diplomats have left their embassy in Kabul, captured by the fundamentalist Taleban last month, the official Iranian news agency IRNA reported on Tuesday.
It said the diplomats have left for other parts of Afghanistan or gone to Pakistan over the last few days. Only one remained in the Kabul mission. It did not say how many have left.
It was the first time in recent years that Iran has reduced its diplomatic corps in Kabul, said the agency, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation.

Iran recognises the ousted Afghan government of Burhanuddin Rabbani, driven out of Kabul by the Taleban. Iranian media has condemned Taleban as manipulated by the United States, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia.
Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati said on Tuesday the turmoil in Afghanistan threatened Iran's national security.
Afghanistan's new Sunni Moslem rulers have said neighbouring Iran continued to provoke the Taleban government despite recent assurances that relations would improve.
